I think you're mistaken. Acid is liquid at room temperature so it is commonly sold on blotter paper. I.e. you don't cut it. You tear the pieces of paper on perforations. Blotter paper used to be safe because LSD was the only drug that was active at such low doses (200 micrograms or less) but now there are harmful research chemicals (2ci among others) that are often sold as acid. It is easy to tell if you received legitimate lysergic acid diethylamide-25 as advertised if you use a test kit. So remember kids, don't take chances with your body. Test your blotters so that you can remove all unnecessary risks.
